message:
Engagement season starts now. If someone you love gets engaged over the holidays, here's what to do first:

• Set a budget
• Draft a rough guest count
• Pick a date and book the venue

Nearly every other decision depends on those three. Twelve months is a comfortable runway, but you can plan a lovely wedding in 6 or fewer.
